source_label: MAPPO同源模拟图像纹理 · T1两相机 · 601样本 · 精度NOT_ACCEPTED
description: Offline appearance fusion from the original MAPPO two-camera RGB/masks and unchanged 601 saved reconstruction states.

model.policy: bit-identical to original source and texture forward model on every saved state

model_compatibility.configuration: legacy analytic model; no healthy_template declared

atlas.cols: τ：后缘0→压力面→前缘→吸力面→后缘1

clock.relationship_to_mappo: same original simulated physical timestamps; t = simulation time - 117

texture_policy.color_policy: RGB converted to gray by unchanged texture engine; original render is Workbench material color
texture_policy.temporal_policy: one fixed appearance atlas per blade from 601 timestamps; geometry moves/deforms at saved 10Hz samples
texture_policy.unknown_policy: never sampled texels retain alpha=0; no invented fill
texture_policy.visual_inspection: actual normalized atlas and original RGB viewed; spanwise stripes, seams and tip-region collage/misprojection visible; appearance accuracy not accepted
limits: rendered simulation images, not field camera measurements
geometry mismatch and incomplete viewpoints can misplace appearance
normalized gray appearance is not calibrated material reflectance
no independent same-source texture truth or field-quality acceptance

sampling_diagnostics.warning_explanation: existing sample_view rounds/casts invalid UV before masking; invalid UV are excluded and zero-weighted; warnings retained in run log
